name: devin-bridge
description: Read-only views of the devin-bridge ACP bridge: session mappings, effective policy, and the no-session connectivity probe. Thin adapter: the extension shells out to the devin-bridge CLI and renders the result — and by construction it can never reach new/resume/prompt/intake, so no session can be created or driven from the editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs the user-installed devin-bridge CLI on demand (the CLI may spawn the user-installed agent binary with the repo as cwd). In Restricted Mode the workspace-configured executable is ignored and checkOnStartup never auto-runs the CLI.

commands.title: devin-bridge: Check policy decision for a capability

devinBridge.checkOnStartup.description: List bridge sessions when VS Code starts
